NEXUS Backend Theme

A modern, intelligent and premium backend experience for Odoo 18 Community. A persistent dark application sidebar with an orange accent, bright rounded content cards, and a built-in Light / Dark toggle — designed to feel like a Fortune-500-grade enterprise product.

Key Features

  • Persistent left application sidebar — pinned on desktop, drawer on mobile
  • Light / Dark content mode toggle (saved per browser)
  • Restyled buttons, forms, statusbar, notebook tabs
  • Restyled list, kanban and calendar views
  • Restyled modals, notifications, scrollbars and focus states
  • No external font / CDN dependency — works on offline installs
  • Pure front-end module — no data migration, safe to install/uninstall

DESIGNED & DEVELOPED BY HỒNG NGỌC PHÚ — INDUSTRIAL MANAGEMENT RESEARCHER, CAN THO UNIVERSITY
